title: VerificationResult / SignerResult: missing PartialEq (duplicate of .11, merge)
description: Per idiom review: PartialEq/Eq should be derived for types used in test assertions. VerificationResult and SignerResult are the primary output types of the library and will commonly appear in test assert_eq!. Neither derives PartialEq. This is already tracked in MIME-b5x.11; filing here as an idiomatic-rust finding for completeness.
